abstract: Production skill for cost-efficient Parallel (parallel.ai) use. Routes each job to the cheapest adequate product and setting, overrides expensive defaults (Search advanced, Responses medium, FindAll enrichment core, CLI pro), prices requests offline with a cost script, and documents the 2026-10-18 pricing, rate limits, free tiers, notify-only spend limits, uncancellable Task runs, FindAll multipliers, and monitor billing.
